digest.component_or_area: retrigger gate / code review block acceptance
propositions: recheck-review refuses all findings including bugfix-size-attestation, even when the ticket carries a current valid plan-review attestation that makes the finding stale
a no-code-change patchset copies the -1 vote forward via changekind conditions, so attestation earned after the block cannot be re-reviewed without a code change

recheck-review should accept bugfix-size-attestation blocks if the bot's latest vote names exactly one blocking finding with that criterion id and the ticket's plan-review attestation classifies as accepted
accepting this case is safe because retrigger eligibility logic reads only privileged durable state (bot vote message and ticket store), never the requesting comment
bugfix-size-attestation blocks containing any other blocking finding, or whose attestation is absent or flagged-invalid, must still refuse
